subject: Velatrix SIG: Evidence collection sprint & control consolidation
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@velatrix.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@velatrix.com>, procurement@velatrix.com
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up + controls we need evidence for

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the quick RFI turnaround last week. Our security team finished an initial pass and we'd like to move into an evidence collection sprint so we can complete Velatrix's SIG and SOC 2 mapping by end of December. Attached is the Velatrix_RFI_SIG_v1.pdf with the gating controls highlighted.

High level asks:
- A controls mapping that shows where Redwood satisfies SIG/CC/ISO clauses (control IDs, description, evidence filename).
- For a subset of high-risk controls (auth, key management, encryption at rest, privileged access, change control, logging), we need specific artifacts: config screenshots, policy documents, sample logs (redacted), and proof of retention.
- A 2-week window where your team can drop artifacts into a shared location (S3 or Drive) and a single point of contact for questions.

Can you confirm:
1) Which internal owners will manage evidence collection?
2) A feasible evidence-delivery sprint date range (we were thinking 29 Nov – 10 Dec)
3) Any PII redaction rules we should be aware of for logs/ingest artifacts.

We'd also like a short mapping spreadsheet to import into our tooling (columns: Velatrix control ID, Redwood control ID, artifact name, owner, notes).

Thanks — hoping to move fast here.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Security Operations
Velatrix

Attachment: Velatrix_RFI_SIG_v1.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@velatrix.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up + controls we need evidence for

Hi Elena — thanks for the attachment and the clear scope. We're ready to run an evidence sprint and proposed owners below.

Quick answers to your questions:
1) Owners:
   - Evidence lead / intake: Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com)
   - Logs / infra artifacts: Priyom Das (priyom.das@redwoodinference.com)
   - Controls mapping & legal redlines: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com)
2) Feasible sprint window: 29 Nov – 10 Dec works for us; we can be flexible by +/- 3 business days.
3) PII redaction: we will provide redaction guidance and sample sanitized logs. For discovery artifacts we prefer to deliver redacted extracts or schema definitions rather than full datasets.

Attached: redwood_control_map_v1.xlsx — this is a template we will use. Please confirm the format works so we can pre-populate the first 50 controls.

Next steps we propose:
- You confirm the scope of the high-risk control list (or point to the page/section in your PDF).
- We run an intake call on 24 Nov to finalize delivery channels (S3 vs Drive) and access.
- Evidence sprint kickoff on 29 Nov.

I'll put Neha and Priyom on the intake call.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood_control_map_v1.xlsx

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@velatrix.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@velatrix.com>, procurement@velatrix.com
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up + controls we need evidence for

Mateo — thanks. A couple clarifications from our side before the intake call:

- The high-risk list is pages 4–6 in the attached PDF (auth, KMS, devops pipeline approvals, emergency access logging, backup/restores, third-party vendor onboarding).
- For logs, we need: a one-week sample of auth and admin logs (redacted), retention policy documents (link to the policy), and a description of live monitoring/alerting rules.
- For KMS: we expect a key lifecycle diagram, proof of HSM/KMS integration, and the most recent key-rotation schedule.

Procurement note (cc): we also need a short statement on licensing/usage terms for the dedicated deployment option, and a draft mutual NDA amendment — procurement will kick off separately but wanted to flag.

Can you provide a runbook for redaction? Also confirm that delivery via a Velatrix-owned S3 bucket (we will create an upload role) is acceptable.

Thanks — Samir

Attachment: (none)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@velatrix.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@velatrix.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up + controls we need evidence for

Hi Elena / Samir — thanks for the detail. Confirming the intake call for Wednesday 24 Nov 11:00 PT (30 minutes) to finalize S3 access and scope. Meeting invite sent out.

Pre-call notes (what we'll deliver during the sprint):
- Pre-populated control mapping (first tranche of 75 controls) in the redwood_control_map_v1.xlsx template.
- Evidence picklist CSV (evidence_picklist_2027-11-24.csv) that lists recommended artifact filenames, target owners, and expected redaction level.
- Sample log export (redwood_audit-logs-sample_2027-10.tar.gz) with PII redacted and a redaction runbook attached in the Drive folder.

Logistics:
- Delivery channel: Velatrix S3 upload role is fine. We'll need an upload role ARN and a short-lived write-only credential or pre-signed url approach.
- Security: We will encrypt artifacts client-side before upload if requested.
- Timeline: Intake today (24 Nov), evidence upload window 29 Nov–10 Dec, internal review completed by 17 Dec.

Notes on limits and exceptions:
- Raw audit logs containing full IAM tokens or full request payloads cannot be exported; we will provide schema + extracted fields with hex-prefix hashes where needed.
- For backups and restore evidence we will provide runbooks and restore-test screenshots rather than full backup blobs.

Drive folder (pre-populated): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-velatrix-evidence-sprint
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/VEL-2027-0912

If that all looks good we'll proceed and bring the artifacts into the Sprint folder after the intake call.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: evidence_picklist_2027-11-24.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@velatrix.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@velatrix.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up + controls we need evidence for

Elena / Samir — appreciate the quick alignment on scope. Two final items from our side before the sprint:

1) Access & legal: Please share the Velatrix S3 upload role ARN or let us know if you prefer pre-signed URLs. Procurement, if you need a short amendment to the existing NDA for artifact handling, please route it to legal@redwoodinference.com and cc me.

2) Acceptance criteria: We'll mark each control as "Complete" in the mapping spreadsheet when: artifact(s) uploaded, owner acknowledged, and a short verification note (screenshot or hash digest) is present. If a control requires follow-up, we'll flag it and add an owner-action in the picklist.

3) Can you confirm whether Velatrix needs any non-disclosure redaction templates for screenshots (we can provide a one-page redaction guidance doc)?

Once we have confirmation on S3 access we will:
- Pre-populate the first 75 rows of the mapping sheet by EOD tomorrow;
- Upload the sample logs and the redaction runbook into the shared folder after the intake call;
- Start the evidence intake on 29 Nov.

Thanks and we look forward to moving quickly.

—Karthik
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
